en: Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4); Tikatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (5). 23.53. The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika);
The Triplet on the Fixed in Wrongness (Micchattaniyatattika).

Conditioned by a state that is non-visible, impinging, and fixed in the wrongness [of view], there arises a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and fixed in the wrongness [of view] by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is non-visible, impinging, and not fixed in the rightness [of view], there arises a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and fixed in the rightness [of view] by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, with resistance, and indeterminate, there arises a state that is visible, with resistance, and indeterminate by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one; under predominance condition there are twenty-one ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are twenty-one.
